from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyConstructionData(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly construction data point extracted from a document."""
    month: str = Field(..., description="The reporting month in YYYY-MM format")
    starts_saar: float | None = Field(None, description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for housing starts")
    completions_saar: float | None = Field(None, description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for housing completions")
    report_release_date: str = Field(..., description="The release date of the report containing this data, used to resolve conflicts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    construction_records: list[MonthlyConstructionData] = Field(..., description="All monthly construction data points found in this document")
